description_for_human: অনলাইন কোরআন শিক্ষক খুঁজুন — সহীহ কোরআন, হেফজ, নাজেরা, তাফসীর, আরবি ভাষা, মাসলা-মাসায়েল ও ইসলামিক শিক্ষার জন্য যোগ্য ও যাচাইকৃত শিক্ষকদের প্রোফাইল দেখুন।
description_for_model: Global Islamic Care (GIC) is an online Islamic teacher platform based in Bangladesh. It connects verified qualified Quran and Islamic studies teachers (Hafez, Alim, Mufti) with students worldwide for 1-on-1 live classes. Services: Sahih Quran recitation, Hifz (memorization), Nazera (fluent reading), Tafseer (exegesis), Arabic language, Islamic jurisprudence (Masla-Masayel), Islamic ethics, and Duas. Students browse teacher profiles at globalislamiccare.com/teachers.html and contact teachers directly via WhatsApp. No commission, no middleman. Free Digital Islamic Library available at globalislamiccare.com/library.html.
